msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia maeve-sevilla-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of colourful gold drop earrings with turquoise, coral and amethyst stones from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia maeve-sevilla-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of gold statement drop earrings with an oval turquoise stone and a coral teardrop from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia maeve-sevilla-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of long white bone bead necklaces and a white carved flamenco hair comb from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia maeve-sevilla-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a clutch bag covered in colourful mirrored mosaic glass stones from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia maeve-sevilla-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of folded embroidered silk Manila shawls in coral, fuchsia, ivory and black from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
